why: #2171: the hit target's leave handler is removed, so only the svg's pointerleave clears the preview and a pointer below the columns keeps it
#2172: the hit target's pointermove restore is removed, so after Escape or a Tab round trip a resting mouse shows the idle prompt until it enters another night
#2169: the preview is gated on pointerType === "mouse" again (on the enter and on the move), so a pen's hover previews nothing
#2169: a pen's click sets the key night without ending the preview, so a pen's tap leaves the preview standing over the tapped night
#2164: the intro timer starts at mount whatever the visibility (the old behaviour), so a page shown late has its intro cut at the timer
#2164: a page first shown late never starts its intro: it is dropped at mount, not deferred
#2171 review round 1: a night's leave ends whatever preview stands, so a pen leaving its night ends the preview a mouse resting on another night took since
#2172 review round 1: the move restore ignores the key night, so after a click and a key step a resting mouse's move pulls the readout back from the key night (round 3 I broken)
#2164 review round 1: a figure mounted hidden counts from its mount, so a page shown late ends its count at its first frame while the sparklines draw in
#2164 review round 1: a count keeps running after its intro is dropped
#2164 review round 1 (F2): a page first shown with its view due a re-read still plays its intro, so the re-read on that show inserts rows that play it
